messages:
maya: Quick midweek buffer/rebalance check — saw a 22% uptick in inference run-rate overnight in APAC, want to confirm whether we should shift more preemptible capacity there or trigger burst nodes from Dedicated pools.
raj: Got the same signal in telemetry. APAC queue depth for small-chat models up ~1.8x, tail latency creeping 150ms on p50 -> p95. Noticed a couple of node-level OOMs in syd-az2.
linh: OOMs were on the 4x16G preemptible pools, looks like batch sizes crept after yesterday's Canary deploy. Rolling back that change for now.
darren: If we increase preemptible mix we risk higher evictions during peak. What's the alternative cost delta to spin burst dedicated for 6 hours?
maya: Quick calc from yesterday's rates: burst dedicated ~ $0.85 / GPU-hour vs preemptible effective ~$0.35 but eviction risk adds ~0.12 expected lost-work cost -> net ~0.47. For a 100-GPU 6-hr window that's ~$102.
raj: Can we temporarily reduce batch-size for APAC small-chat overlays to remove OOM pressure? That'd be lower-risk than capacity moves.
linh: I'll patch the router to clamp microbatch to 4 for the small-chat route. Pushing in 5m.
sre-bot: notice: syd-az2 node-group reported 2 preemption events in last 30m, autoscaler attempted 3 replacements.
maya: Good, thanks. Also we should rebalance cached KV hotspots — APAC cache hit dropped from 0.78 -> 0.63 which is increasing token compute. Any quick cache invalidation suspects?
raj: Looks like the new personalized prompt prefix experiment for a single customer is disabling prefix caching (missed header). I'll open a ticket to revert.
darren: Action items: (1) linh clamps microbatch for small-chat (in flight), (2) raj reverts prefix cache change and confirms hit-ratio within 2hrs, (3) maya to sign off on dedicated burst if latency doesn't recover by EOD.
maya: Also tag finance on the estimated $102 for 6hr burst in the ticket, but prefer scaling config changes first.
linh: Patch deployed — microbatch clamp set to 4, monitoring now.
raj: Rolling back prefix change now, will post run-rate + cache hit after roll.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: patch applied to router-service (rev 2026.3.118) — no errors reported in rollout.
maya: Thanks all. If we still see p95 > 600ms in APAC in 30m we trigger dedicated-burst. Everyone ping here with quick readouts, otherwise I'll close the loop at EOD. :thumbsup:
